## Why

The correction-intake receiver and its moderation surface are built but
deliberately non-operational. Before anyone can ever open them, the C4
review found the operating path was unsafe: the PostgreSQL reviewer-detail
route 500'd on UUID serialisation (NEW-8), the operating gate ignored the
`owner`/`staffed` fields it already read from config (NEW-15), published
demo tokens stayed valid on a DSN-backed curation app (NEW-30), the abuse
limiter keyed on an unnormalised client and charged refusals (NEW-16), the
reporter could never see how their report ended (NEW-17), a proposal's
value shape was not checked until apply time (NEW-18), and the form had a
silent wrong-category default, no viewport meta and hand-typed identifiers
(NEW-19). The receiver stays non-operational in Round 11 (B-8, WV-05).

## What ships

- **UUID-safe reviewer detail** (`db/src/db/intake.py::_row`): psycopg's
  `uuid.UUID`/`datetime` values serialise (element-wise inside lists) —
  `GET /v1/curation/intake/{receipt}` returns 200 over the PG store.
- **Fail-closed operating gate** (`api/intake.py::intake_operational` +
  `ops/config.toml`): all of `[intake].operational`,
  `SIG_INTAKE_OPERATIONAL=1`, non-empty `owner`, `staffed = true` required;
  committed config stays `operational = false`, `owner = ""`,
  `staffed = false` (B-8).
- **No demo tokens on a real deployment** (`api/curation.py`,
  `tier_tokens.py::without_demo_tokens`): any DSN-backed curation app —
  `dsn` arg, DSN-string intake store, or a pre-built PG queue/store —
  resolves only provisioned invite tokens; published demo keys answer 401.
- **Edge-normalised limiter** (`api/intake.py`): `[intake].trusted_proxy_hops`
  (default 0) declares how many forwarding hops are documented; the
  Nth-from-right `Forwarded`/`X-Forwarded-For` entry keys the bucket and a
  client-claimed header alone is never trusted. The submission limiter now
  runs only after the form token, field validation and the idempotency
  dedupe — a refusal (422/403/413/retry) never burns the allowance; failed
  status lookups keep their own edge-keyed counter.
- **Reporter outcome + linkage** (new sqitch change
  `intake_reporter_outcome` + `public_status` + `/intake/v1/status`):
  `intake.report_public` gains `outcome`, `correction_ref`,
  `publication_id`, `tombstone` — derived from the append-only event log,
  grants and the restricted-column boundary unchanged (deployed and
  verified under the real roles; `published` fixtures are written by
  `sig_intake_bridge`, the only role the writer guard admits). The status
  response adds `outcome`, the approved `response`, `publication_id`,
  `correction_ref`, `tombstone` and `result_url` (`/r/<pub>/` or
  `/corrections/`) once the decision is published. Approving a proposal
  that carries a publishable response inherits it, so the reporter reads
  the text the approver actually approved.
- **Proposal shape at proposal time** (`policy/intake.py` +
  `intake_receiver.toml [proposal.object_value]` + `db/intake_apply.py`):
  `object_type` is required on `correct`/`annotate` proposals; the single
  table of record checks `required ⊆ present ⊆ required∪optional` at
  proposal time and the bridge re-checks the declared type against the
  resolved target type at apply (`object_type_mismatch` — a validated
  proposal can never be unapplicable).
- **Form + deep links** (`api/intake.py` + `exports/release_pages.py`):
  viewport meta on every receiver page; a disabled placeholder option
  forces a real category; `GET /intake/new?publication_id=&record_key=
  &claim_ids=` prefills only contract-shaped values; record pages carry a
  "Report this record" deep link that resolves to `/dispute/?<context>`
  while the receiver is dark and `/intake/new?…` only when a build sets
  `SIG_INTAKE_DEEPLINK=1`. Form copy no longer promises anonymous or
  one-click intake (WV-05; the Round-11 public channel is e-mail).

## Boundaries

The receiver is not opened: `[intake].operational` stays `false`, no
`SIG_INTAKE_OPERATIONAL` is set anywhere, `/intake/` still answers
`503 receiver_not_operating`, and no public copy promises anonymous or
one-click intake (the Round-11 channel is e-mail, WV-05/ADR-180). No
spine writes outside tests (the bridge is exercised on the throwaway
testcontainer only), no ingestion-permission flips, no human gates ticked,
no production mutation, no CI config change, no new verdict words, no
DEFERRALS lead-token changes (D-P32.16-1 stays owed to P37.59/operator),
`db/sqitch.plan` L44–52 untouched (C-10), the new plan line's `planned_at`
is a `date -u` record date.
